newsitem.title: USA: SBS Tech sets acquisition, sees Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: SBS Tech sets acquisition, sees Q2 loss.

text.p: SBS Technologies Inc said Wednesday it had agreed to acquire Bit 3 Computer Corp for $24 million.
SBS said the deal would result in an $11 million charge in its second quarter and lead to an anticipated loss for that period.
The deal is expected to close in the second quarter, ended December 31, it said.
An initial cash payment of $20 million is to be funded primarily by an offering of SBS stock. The company filed on Wednesday to offer 1.8 million shares.
The deal is contingent on the initial cash payment, with cash payments of $1 million and $3 millionn to follow in 1997 and 1998, respectively.
As a result of the acquisition, SBS said it will record $9.75 million of intangible assets, including goodwill.
It also will post an estimated $11 million charge related to in-process research and development of purchased technology of Bit 3. The charge is expected to be recorded in the second quarter.
The company said that based on its past financial performance and that of Bit 3, it anticipates a "significant net loss" for the second quarter as a result of the charge.
Bit 3 is a manufacturer of computer networking and interconnection hardware.
